app.subtitle: Your iPhone's internet on your laptop
wifi.host.label: iPhone IP
wifi.host.hint: Shown in the iPhone app, under Connection.
systemProxy.title: System proxy
systemProxy.hint: Browsers and apps use the iPhone. Restored when you disconnect.
environmentProxy.title: Variables for terminal and dev apps
environmentProxy.hint: HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY for Claude Code, Codex, git and npm. Restart those apps after connecting.
environmentProxy.unsupported: Not available on this system. Use “Copy for terminal”.
systemProxy.unsupported: Not available on this desktop. Use the terminal option or set up each app.
advanced.port.hint: Same as in the iPhone app's Settings. Default: 1080.
status.disconnected.detail: Start the proxy on the iPhone and click Connect.
status.environmentProxyOn: Environment variables on: restart open apps so they use them
status.reconnecting.detail: The iPhone stopped responding. Hoply keeps trying: keep the app open on the iPhone and the cable plugged in.
status.unverified.detail: No response through the iPhone. Make sure the proxy is running in the app.
status.restoreFailed.detail: The previous settings couldn't be restored. The app will try again next time it opens.
failure.usbService.windows: Install the Apple Devices app or iTunes so Windows recognizes the iPhone.
failure.usbService.macos: The macOS device service isn't responding. Unplug the cable and plug it in again.
failure.usbService.linux: Install and enable usbmuxd: sudo apt install usbmuxd
failure.deviceNotFound: No iPhone is connected by cable. Plug it in and tap “Trust”.
failure.portInUse: Port {0} is already in use on this laptop. Close the other program or change the port under Advanced and in the iPhone app.
failure.systemProxy: The system proxy couldn't be configured. Turn that option off and use the terminal or each app.
failure.environmentProxy: Couldn't set the environment variables. Turn that option off and use “Copy for terminal”.
forward.deviceMissing: The cable was unplugged. Plug it in again.
forward.refused: The proxy isn't running on the iPhone, or it uses another port.
forward.other: Couldn't open the connection to the iPhone.
validation.port: The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
validation.host: Enter the iPhone's IP, for example 192.168.1.20.
